title: Jamaican Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew inspired by the islands, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is a great way to warm up on a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add nurturing greens, Jamaican seasoning, and hibiscus tea.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
